stemMd: What does the added note help prevent?

options.label: A
options.textMd: Changes to the street layout in the real town

options.label: B
options.textMd: The model from displaying volume relationships

options.label: C
options.textMd: Mistaking an unresolved feature for an intentional final choice

explanationMd: The note marks the boundary between developed and unresolved information. It allows the model to remain selective while reducing the risk that blankness or simplification will be read as a committed design choice.

distractorRationale.a: A note cannot directly control the town’s streets.
distractorRationale.d: Clarifying scope does not eliminate aesthetic disagreement.
distractorRationale.e: Those decisions still need to be made.
